name: ai-dotfiles
description: Shareable Codex and AI agent configuration files.

scripts.check: node --test export.test.mjs && node export.js --dry-run && npm run check:agent-dev && npm run check:skill-links && npm run check:plugin-tools && npm run check:plugins
scripts.check:agent-dev: npm run check:agent-dev:common && node --input-type=module -e "if (process.platform === 'win32') { const { spawnSync } = await import('node:child_process'); const r = spawnSync('pwsh', ['-NoProfile', '-File', 'scripts/test-install-agent.ps1'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1); }"
scripts.check:plugins: node plugins/agent-plugin-tools/skills/plugin-creator-agent-plugins/scripts/validate-agent-plugin.mjs plugins/agent-design-tools && node plugins/agent-plugin-tools/skills/plugin-creator-agent-plugins/scripts/validate-agent-plugin.mjs plugins/agent-plugin-tools && node plugins/agent-plugin-tools/skills/plugin-creator-agent-plugins/scripts/validate-agent-plugin.mjs plugins/ai-dotfiles-cli && node plugins/agent-plugin-tools/skills/plugin-creator-agent-plugins/scripts/validate-agent-plugin.mjs plugins/agent-eval-tools && node plugins/agent-plugin-tools/skills/plugin-creator-agent-plugins/scripts/validate-agent-plugin.mjs plugins/dot-toolkit && node --test scripts/plugin-packages.test.mjs
